$comment: Mimir application update manifest. The installed app fetches this over HTTPS to learn whether a newer version exists; it never downloads or executes anything from here — when an update is available the app only opens downloadPageUrl in the customer's browser. 'available: false' is the honest current state: no public Mimir installer is published yet, so no in-app update prompt is shown. To announce a release: bump latestVersion (semver), set publishedAt, set available to true once the download page really serves installers. Never point downloadPageUrl anywhere but this site.
